readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on any cold executable whole line inside a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary, nullish, optional-chain, or compound-condition operand sharing one physical line, so cold sub-line regions and focused helper/delegation tests remain complementary evidence. EXCLUSIONS (2026-09-30): every whole line this spec leaves out of its ranges because no plan that parses can execute it is named, with the reason and whatever direct test pins it, in the note of the entry it was cut from; the pieces that continue that entry carry its id with a numeric suffix. The blocks corpus reaches every other line of every range.
